plan.title: Issue cockpit: full-width agent conversations — lift tab strip, dissolve Conversation tab, Tasks rail → chip + drawer
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Clicking an agent in the issue cockpit squeezes its conversation into the center cell of a three-column grid (agents lane ≤264px | main | tasks 256px), and the 11 detail tabs wrap to two rows inside that same center column. The transcript — the surface operators read most — gets the least width.
narratives.Proposal: Per the operator-approved mockup and PRD decisions D-1..D-6: lift the Detail Tabs nav out of the center column into one full-width non-wrapping row between the header and the body grid; remove the Conversation tab (clicking an agent in the spine IS the conversation, and the tab's cards relocate into the issue-context body so nothing is lost); replace the 256px Tasks rail with a Tasks chip in the tab band that opens a slide-over drawer rendering the existing TasksRail; make the agent spine collapsible to a 56px icon rail persisted in localStorage; cap the transcript at a centered 980px measure at the cockpit call site. All responsive behavior uses @container queries; no new data paths; the issue-view no-loss gate stays green.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes to the outer Command Deck shell (Awareness column, project tree, pane resizing) — already solved, out of scope
- No rebuild of Review → sub-reviewer convoy nesting — it already exists in AgentsLane.tsx (reviewExpanded)
- No changes to the rail or console densities of the issue-view kit — cockpit only
- No modification of the SessionPanel component itself (other consumers exist) — the 980px cap wraps it at the cockpit call site only
- No new endpoints, polling loops, store slices, query keys, or direct canonical-state access
- No deletion or rename of any DENSITY_SECTIONS.cockpit / ISSUE_VIEW_INVENTORY section name
- No viewport media queries — container queries only
- No hidden data-section marker elements to satisfy the no-loss gate

autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD is operator-approved with an approved interactive mockup as the visual target; every file/anchor citation was re-verified against the workspace at 1e8a7bc6c9.

autoDecisions.rationale: When authoritative inputs name acceptable options, auto mode picks the one matching the operator-approved mockup rather than asking.

autoDecisions.rationale: Removing the Tasks rail column without the chip in the same commit would break the always-green no-loss gate; the slice is genuinely indivisible.

items.title: Lift the Detail Tabs nav into a full-width single-row tab band

expected_outputs: IssueMissionControl.test.tsx passes, including a new assertion that the Detail Tabs nav is not a descendant of <main> and all tab labels render

narrative.Action: Per PRD D-1/WI-1: move the <nav data-section="Detail Tabs"> block (search `data-section="Detail Tabs"` in IssueMissionControl.tsx) out of <main> so the cockpit wrap's children are <header>, the tab band, then <div className={styles.missionBody}>. Restyle the nav: `flex flex-nowrap gap-1 overflow-x-auto` (drop `flex-wrap`), replace `font-semibold` with `font-medium`, and style the active tab as the mockup's rounded pill (`bg-primary/9 text-primary`). Leave selectTab, tabBadge, and all activeTab logic untouched. Update IssueMissionControl.test.tsx accordingly.

items.title: Given a cockpit pane ≥840px, the Detail Tabs nav renders exactly once as a direct child of the cockpit wrap between the header and the body grid — the component test asserts the nav is NOT a descendant of <main>.

Given a 500px-wide container, the tab band renders all tabs on a single line (the nav carries flex-nowrap and overflow-x-auto and no flex-wrap), scrolling horizontally instead of wrapping to a second row.
Every remaining tab label renders in the band and each tabBadge count renders next to its tab.
The moved nav uses font-medium (no font-semibold anywhere in the touched markup) and the active tab renders the rounded-pill classes bg-primary/9 text-primary.
Dissolve the Conversation tab; relocate its cards into the issue-context body

expected_outputs: typecheck completes without errors (proves 'conversation' is gone from the MissionTab union with no dangling usages)
IssueMissionControl.test.tsx and MissionConversationTab.test.tsx pass, including assertions that no Conversation tab renders and the issue-context body shows Overview plus the Launch card

narrative.Action: Per PRD D-2/WI-2: remove { id: 'conversation', label: 'Conversation' } from TABS, remove 'conversation' from the MissionTab union, and delete the activeTab === 'conversation' branch. Do NOT delete MissionConversationTab: change IssueTreeContextPanel's `if (context === 'issue') return <OverviewTab …>` branch to return OverviewTab followed by MissionConversationTab in the existing spacing container, and drop the now-dead trailing `return <MissionConversationTab …>` fallback. Keep the data-section="Conversation / Files / Terminal tabs" marker on the relocated MissionConversationTab wrapper (the Files/Terminal tab-body markers stay where they are). Grep for any remaining selectTab('conversation') callers and retarget them to openAgentByType('work') with selectTab('overview') fallback — the exact pattern already used in handlePhaseClick.

items.title: No tab labeled "Conversation" renders; 'conversation' is removed from both TABS and the MissionTab union, and typecheck passes with zero remaining 'conversation' MissionTab usages.
When a session is selected from the spine, the main column renders the SessionPanel region (data-section="SessionPanel") in the full-width main panel.

The issue-context body (after "Back to issue") renders the Overview content followed by the MissionConversationTab cards (Launch / Agents / Quick tools / Conversation timeline) — a strict superset of what the Conversation tab showed.
The relocated MissionConversationTab wrapper preserves a visible data-section="Conversation / Files / Terminal tabs" element even while the Files and Terminal tabs are closed.
Replace the Tasks rail column with a tab-band Tasks chip + slide-over drawer

expected_outputs: IssueMissionControl.test.tsx passes: chip shows the done/total rollup, clicking it mounts TasksRail content, and the onOpenFull path switches to the Tasks view; TasksSections.test.tsx stays green

narrative.Action: Per PRD D-3/WI-3: (1) change the ≥840px grid template in cockpitBody.module.css (search `grid-template-columns: minmax(210px, 264px)`) from three columns to `minmax(210px, 264px) minmax(0, 1fr)` and remove the <div data-section="TasksRail / TasksTab"> grid child that renders TasksRail. (2) Add a right-aligned (margin-left: auto) Tasks chip to the tab band carrying data-section="TasksRail / TasksTab" — a real, always-visible element — showing `done/total` plus a small progress bar, computed from the SAME useQuery data TasksRail already fetches (query key /api/issues/:id/tasks); extract a small shared rollup helper using the existing taskStatusBucket from src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/taskStatus.ts rather than a second fetch or second bucketing implementation. (3) Add a TasksDrawer component: absolutely-positioned right-anchored panel + scrim inside the cockpit wrap (per the mockup), aria-label="Plan progress", closing on Escape and scrim click, whose body renders <TasksRail issueId={issueId} onOpenFull={() => { closeDrawer(); selectTab('beads') }} /> unchanged. The hidden beads tab and TasksTab are untouched. Style-guide: badge tint 8%/32%, no rounded-full pills, no hardcoded hex.

items.title: At ≥840px container width the body grid renders exactly two columns (spine + main) — the 256px Tasks rail column and its grid child are removed.

The tab band renders an always-visible right-aligned Tasks chip carrying data-section="TasksRail / TasksTab" that shows <done>/<total> derived from the existing tasks query data — no new query key, endpoint, or polling loop is introduced.
Clicking the chip opens a slide-over drawer that renders the existing TasksRail content unchanged; pressing Escape or clicking the scrim closes it.
Clicking "Open full" inside the drawer closes the drawer and switches the cockpit to the full Tasks view (the beads tab renders TasksTab).
The done/total rollup returns its counts from one shared helper that applies the existing taskStatusBucket; the diff contains no second bucketing implementation and no second fetch.
Make the agent spine collapsible to a 56px icon rail

expected_outputs: component test passes: the toggle flips aria-expanded, persists to localStorage['overdeck.cockpit.spineCollapsed'], and the collapsed state restores on remount

narrative.Action: Per PRD D-4/WI-4: add a collapse toggle (a real <button> with aria-expanded) to the spine header area — the <aside> wrapper around IssueTreeLane in IssueMissionControl.tsx. Collapsed state adds a conditional .spineCollapsed class on .missionBody; in cockpitBody.module.css add `.missionBody.spineCollapsed { grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); }` INSIDE the same @container (min-width: 840px) block (container query, never a viewport media query). Collapsed rows render the icon tile only, centered, with name/model/status hidden via CSS rules in agentsLane.module.css under the collapsed class (prefer CSS-class-driven hiding over a new AgentsLane prop to keep the component API stable) and a native title tooltip carrying name + status. Persist the choice as localStorage['overdeck.cockpit.spineCollapsed'], defaulting to expanded.

items.title: A <button> with aria-expanded in the spine header toggles the collapsed state; when collapsed the grid's first column renders at 56px via the .spineCollapsed class under @container (min-width: 840px).
Collapsed rows render icon tiles only with a native title tooltip containing the agent name and status, and clicking an icon row still opens that agent's conversation.
The collapsed choice persists to localStorage['overdeck.cockpit.spineCollapsed'], restores on remount, and defaults to expanded when the key is absent.

SessionPanel.tsx itself has zero changes in the diff — the cap applies only at the cockpit call site.
